This gives you an overview of your current medication and precise instructions on how to take your medication, when therapy starts and ends. The pill and package images are also recorded on the eMediplan so that you can recognize and assign the medication - even without packaging. You have also access to the package insert in the app.
2.	Overview of daily medication intake: Your daily medication intake is displayed clearly and chronologically so that you know exactly which medication to take and when.
3.	Pill reminder: The app reminds you to take your medication so that you do not forget to take it. This reminder function increases patients' adherence to medication and ultimately increases patient safety.

	b.	The app automatically counts the drug stock according to the posology
